import json, os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])
import prismabuild.client as client
tree = os.path.realpath(os.path.join(sys.argv[1], 'prismabuild'))
served = os.path.realpath(client.__file__)
if os.path.commonpath([tree, served]) != tree:
    sys.exit(f'prismabuild.client served from {served}, not the tree {tree}')
print(json.dumps({'sdk_version': client.SDK_VERSION, 'capabilities': sorted(client.CAPABILITIES)}))

import base64,importlib.util,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(importlib.util.find_spec("transformers").origin).parent
p=root/"models/glm5_next/modeling_glm5_next.py"; h=root/"integrations/hub_kernels.py"
print(json.dumps(dict(path=str(p),source=base64.b64encode(p.read_bytes()).decode(),hub=base64.b64encode(h.read_bytes()).decode())))

import json, sys; from prismaquant.joint_adjoint_slices import band_set, stage_a_run_header, stage_a_run_header_sha256; bands = [json.load(open(p)) for p in sys.argv[1:]]; indexed = band_set(bands); print(json.dumps({'boundaries': sorted(indexed), 'run_header_sha256': stage_a_run_header_sha256(stage_a_run_header(bands[0]))}))

def digest(root):
    h=hashlib.sha256(); n=0
    for p in sorted(q for q in root.rglob('*') if q.is_file()):
        rel=p.relative_to(root)
        if set(rel.parts)&SKIP_DIRS or p.suffix in SKIP_SUF: continue
        dotted='.'.join(('tessera',)+rel.parts[:-1])
        if any(fnmatch(dotted,x) for x in UNSHIPPED): continue
        h.update(str(rel).encode()); h.update(b'\0')
        h.update(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().encode())
        h.update(b'\n'); n+=1
    return h.hexdigest(), n
try:
    c = resources.files('tessera.serving').joinpath('runtime_contract.json')
    pkg = Path(str(resources.files('tessera')))
    d, n = digest(pkg)
    out = {'contract_sha256': hashlib.sha256(c.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
           'package_sha256': d, 'package_files': n,
           'package_path': str(pkg)}
except Exception as exc:
    out = {'reason': type(exc).__name__ + ': ' + str(exc)}
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(out))

verification.assertions:
import ast, hashlib, json, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from tools import duplication_inventory as inventory
root = Path.cwd()
document = json.loads((root / "docs/audits/digest_site_census_pq1301_2026-10-04.json").read_text())
fresh = document["refresh_2540"]
def validate(fresh):
    calls = fresh["calls"]
    ids = [row["id"] for row in calls]
    assert len(ids) == len(set(ids)), "duplicate call"
    live = inventory.digest_sites(root)
    assert fresh["scan_sites"] == live
    actual = set()
    for path in inventory._files(root):
        rel = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())
        aliases = inventory._import_aliases(tree)
        for call, scope in inventory._iter_scoped_calls(tree):
            callee = inventory._resolved_callee(call.func, aliases)
            family = "hashlib" if callee and callee.startswith("hashlib.") else "sorted-json" if callee in ("json.dumps", "json.JSONEncoder") and any(k.arg == "sort_keys" and isinstance(k.value, ast.Constant) and k.value.value is True for k in call.keywords) else None
            if family:
                actual.add(f"{family}:{rel}::{scope}@{call.lineno}:{call.col_offset}")
    assert set(ids) == actual, "missing or unknown calls"
    assert {row["site"] for row in calls} == set(live)
    ratchet = {row["site"] for row in calls if row["ratcheted"]}
    baseline = json.loads(inventory.BASELINE.read_text())["primitive_digest_sites"]
    assert ratchet == set(baseline) == set(fresh["ratchet_sites"])
    rows = calls + fresh["supplemental_calls"]
    all_ids = {row["id"] for row in rows}
    assert len(all_ids) == len(rows)
    modules = fresh["module_owners"]
    assert len({row["file"] for row in modules}) == len(modules), "duplicate module owner"
    assert {row["file"] for row in modules} == {row["file"] for row in rows if row["file"] not in inventory.DIGEST_OWNERS}, "missing module owner"
    module_members = [rid for module in modules for rid in module["calls"]]
    assert len(module_members) == len(set(module_members))
    assert set(module_members) == {row["id"] for row in rows if row["file"] not in inventory.DIGEST_OWNERS}
    owners = {row["file"]: row["epic"] for row in modules}
    cohorts = fresh["contract_cohorts"]
    assert len({row["id"] for row in cohorts}) == len(cohorts)
    members = [rid for cohort in cohorts for rid in cohort["calls"]]
    assert len(members) == len(set(members)), "duplicate cohort member"
    assert set(members) == {row["id"] for row in rows if row["eligible"]}
    assignments = {rid: cohort for cohort in cohorts for rid in cohort["calls"]}
    for row in rows:
        if row["eligible"]:
            assert isinstance(row["owner"]["gap" if row["owner"]["route"] is None else "route"], str)
        if row["disposition"] == "owner-implementation":
            assert row["owner"]["implementation"] and row["owner"]["route"] is None and row["owner"]["gap"] is None, "owner site has consumer disposition"
    for row in rows:
        assert row["classification"] in {"load-bearing", "ephemeral"}
        for field in ("algorithm", "encoding_options", "input_order", "framing", "digest_bits", "result_type", "read_boundaries", "refusal_behavior"):
            assert field in row["recipe"]
        assert row["source_blob"] == fresh["source_blobs"][row["file"]]["git_blob"]
        if row["eligible"]:
            cohort = assignments[row["id"]]
            assert row["cohort"] == cohort["id"]
            assert row["epic"] == cohort["epic"] == owners[row["file"]]
            assert bool(row["owner"]["route"]) != bool(row["owner"]["gap"])
        if row["disposition"] == "retain":
            assert row["retention_evidence"] and row["retention_evidence"]["reference"], "retention without evidence"
    for name, identity in fresh["source_blobs"].items():
        raw = (root / name).read_bytes() if identity["mode"] != "120000" else str((root/name).readlink()).encode()
        assert hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(raw)).encode("ascii") + b"\0" + raw).hexdigest() == identity["git_blob"], name
        assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == identity["sha256"], name
validate(fresh)
print("PASS: exact call coverage, recipes, exclusive cohorts, module owners, retentions, and source blobs")
